title: Diagram-MMU: A Multi-Modal Benchmark for Scientific Diagrams
abstract: arXiv:2608.12262v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been growing the capability for scientific writing and collaboration. For example, OpenAI Prism is a free workspace for scientific writing and collaboration. One important feature in Prism is turning scientific diagrams directly into LaTeX TikZ code. In this paper, we build a benchmark, Diagram-MMU, a multi-modal benchmark designed to assess MLLMs' ability for scientific diagram parsing and understanding. Diagram-MMU features 3.7k curated diagrams and 18.3k human-validated questions across six domains. It evaluates MLLMs on three tasks common in vibe writing workspaces: diagram-to-code parsing, diagram-to-code editing, and diagram question answering, alongside agentic settings per task. translated_title: 图MMU：一个用于科学图表的多模态基准测试
translated_abstract: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在科学写作和协作方面的能力不断增强。例如，OpenAI Prism是一个用于科学写作和协作的免费工作空间。Prism的一个重要功能是将科学图表直接转换为LaTeX TikZ代码。在本文中，我们构建了一个基准测试Diagram-MMU，这是一个多模态基准测试，旨在评估MLLMs在科学图表解析和理解方面的能力。Diagram-MMU包含3.7k个精选图表和18.3k个人类验证的问题，涵盖六个领域。它评估MLLMs在vibe写作工作空间中常见的三个任务：图表到代码解析、图表到代码编辑和图表问答，以及每个任务的代理设置。对12个MLLMs的评估显示，图表到代码任务比图表问答更具挑战性：模型可以在图表上进行良好推理，但难以解析和编辑它们，这突显了...
tldr: 该基准测试揭示了多模态模型在科学图表解析和编辑方面存在显著短板，尽管它们能有效推理图表内容。
en_tdlr: This benchmark reveals that multimodal models have significant shortcomings in parsing and editing scientific diagrams, despite being able to reason effectively about diagram content.
